svg.text: Milliseconds in the retry loop (attempts and sleeps, without the client's queue), by percentile of calls. Each panel has its own y scale.
Abandoned calls are included. The three repetitions are pooled. Lakebase, 1 CU, 150 workers, 100 ms lock_timeout, 2026-11-24.
